caption: The drawing features a decorative object centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The object consists of a horizontally aligned, gold ornamental band with scalloped edges and circular cutouts. At the center of the band is a large, detailed bow rendered in golden-yellow with visible shading and texture to represent folds. In the middle of the bow, there is an ornate white flower with a gold center and small, gold details radiating from the middle, adding definition to the petals. Below the decorative object and slightly to the right, the name "HELEN BYINGTON" is printed in small, light gray capital letters. The overall composition is symmetrical along the vertical axis, with the central band and bow situated horizontally across the page.
title: Tie-back
